channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: GMB warns delays threaten future of Ferguson Marine yard
item.description: GMB Scotland has accused the Scottish Government of allowing avoidable delays in ferry procurement to jeopardise the future of Ferguson Marine, the union stated. The post GMB warns delays threaten future of Ferguson Marine yard first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK goes ‘all in’ on AUKUS as nuke sub delivery phase begins
item.description: The UK, US and Australia have declared AUKUS "full steam ahead" after Washington completed its internal review, with all three governments shifting from planning to delivery of submarines and advanced tech. The post UK goes ‘all in’ on AUKUS as nuke sub delivery phase begins first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock notes progress in Sweden and Denmark frigate bids
item.description: At the latest meeting of the Scottish Parliament’s Cross Party Group on Maritime and Shipbuilding, Babcock signalled that the Danish and Swedish naval programmes it is competing in are approaching decisive phases. The post Babcock notes progress in Sweden and Denmark frigate bids first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Raybird recon drone shows UK potential in Iron Titan trials
item.description: Skyeton Prevail Solutions says its battle-tested Raybird unmanned aircraft has completed its first UK deployment during the British Army’s Iron Titan exercise. The post Raybird recon drone shows UK potential in Iron Titan trials first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russian submarine tracked through British waters
item.description: The submarine Krasnodar, accompanied by the tug Altay, travelled on the surface from the North Sea, through the Strait of Dover and into the Channel despite severe weather. The post Russian submarine tracked through British waters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Large drone submarine joins British fleet
item.description: The Royal Navy has taken ownership of XV Excalibur, a 12-metre Extra-Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle described by the Ministry of Defence as the largest autonomous submarine ever trialled by the service. The post Large drone submarine joins British fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Norway-UK Qinetiq drills spotlight NATO mission readiness
item.description: Newly released material from QinetiQ offers a clear window into how NATO forces have been sharpening their air and missile defences across the North Atlantic at a time of deepening military cooperation between Britain and Norway. The post Norway-UK Qinetiq drills spotlight NATO mission readiness first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Downie links Scotland’s future to skills and security
item.description: "The quiet networks of trust are the strongest parts of our infrastructure," he said, adding that a secure Scotland depends on renewing opportunity across both defence and civilian sectors. The post Downie links Scotland’s future to skills and security first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Half of Britain’s destroyer fleet now have power issue fixed
item.description: Three of the Royal Navy’s Type 45 destroyers have now completed the long-running Power Improvement Project (PIP) to resolve previous power generation problems. The post Half of Britain’s destroyer fleet now have power issue fixed first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland
item.description: A Virginia-class nuclear submarine of the U.S. Navy has arrived in Scotland for a routine port visit. The post American nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
